# Overview

Reproduces the sex-prediction row of Table 1 in Oh et al. (2026).
RAV-RF (six selected RAVs) is compared against the XIST/Y-chromosome
gene panel on TCGA BRCA/UCEC/OV/PRAD via 5-fold cross-validation.

The canonical artefact for this vignette is
`results/aim1_sex_metrics.rds`, produced by
`benchmark/aim1_sex.R` in the companion repository. This vignette
re-runs the same code path against the live `curatedTCGAData` mirror,
so numbers may differ slightly if cohort composition has changed
upstream.

# Setup

```{r}
library(InferPheno)
library(curatedTCGAData)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
library(TCGAutils)

rav_model <- load_rav_model()
```

# Cohort assembly

```{r}
train_codes <- c("BRCA", "UCEC", "OV", "PRAD")
mae <- curatedTCGAData(diseaseCode = train_codes,
                       assays = "RNASeq2Gene",
                       version = "2.1.1", dry.run = FALSE)

expr_list <- lapply(train_codes, function(code) {
  se <- mae[[paste0(code, "_RNASeq2Gene-20160128")]]
  list(expr = SummarizedExperiment::assay(se),
       pheno = data.frame(
         sample_id = colnames(se),
         cohort    = code,
         phenotype = MultiAssayExperiment::colData(mae)[
           match(TCGAutils::TCGAbarcode(colnames(se)),
                 rownames(MultiAssayExperiment::colData(mae))),
           "gender"]))
})
expr  <- do.call(cbind, lapply(expr_list, `[[`, "expr"))
pheno <- do.call(rbind, lapply(expr_list, `[[`, "pheno"))
pheno$phenotype <- tolower(as.character(pheno$phenotype))
pheno <- pheno[pheno$phenotype %in% c("male", "female"), ]
```

# RAV projection + 5-fold CV

```{r}
rav <- project_to_rav(expr, rav_model)
dat <- join_rav_pheno(rav, pheno)

selected_ravs <- paste0("RAV", c(1076, 1241, 152, 220, 221, 2514))

cv_rf <- cv_oof(dat, selected_ravs, k = 5L, fitter = fit_rf, seed = 1L)
panel <- run_xist_y_panel(expr)
panel_prob <- panel$prob[match(dat$sample_id, rownames(panel$prob)), "male"]
```

# Metrics

```{r}
list(rf    = auc_ci(dat$phenotype, cv_rf$male),
     panel = auc_ci(dat$phenotype, panel_prob),
     delong_rf_vs_panel = paired_delong(
       dat$phenotype, cv_rf$male, panel_prob))
```
